checks.title: Confirm exception outcome and owners
checks.instructions: Name the Operations investigation owner, Support case and message owner, first review result, contact deadline and excluded actions.

checks.title: Bind one exact order exception
checks.instructions: Record business, order, payment, fulfillment, shipment and customer IDs, promised time, time zone and stable case key. Never join by email, amount or display name alone.

checks.title: Bind exact support case and recipient
checks.instructions: Record current helpdesk case ID and revision, linked order/customer IDs, recipient reference, channel, last customer message and prior contact. A case for another order cannot receive this artifact.

checks.title: Set state and contact rules
checks.instructions: Record paid/captured, fulfillment and carrier meanings; missing acceptance scan is pickup unverified, not lost or delivered. Record exception threshold, refund and reship owner, customer-claim policy and message approval rule.

checks.title: Bind ready Operations and Support Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect compatible existing Crews. Bind ready Order Operations Coordinator and Support Reply Drafter IDs and skills; create only after reviewed owner/access scope.

checks.title: Probe exact source joins
checks.instructions: Read a real authorized order, payment, fulfillment, carrier event history, current case and prior contact for one exception. Save exact source IDs, revisions, observed times and gaps; a named SaaS product is not access.

checks.title: Block Support on invalid order evidence
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator on the exact order artifact before Support consumes it and on the resulting update. Reject wrong order/customer/case, label-only delivery, false loss, false refund and sent-message claims. Re-read changed source state.

checks.title: Review concrete route
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source and artifact paths, blocking validator steps, case join, owner action, contact approval boundary, deduplication rule, privacy, cost and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one authorized exception manually
checks.instructions: Use real or historical current source records. Save run and validator IDs, reviewed classification, actual case state, owner corrections and unsent update or no-message reason. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed recurrence
checks.instructions: Record order/case/action keys, approvals, provider receipts if a later send is authorized, and next check. Choose manual-only or a reviewed authenticated event/cadence with replay protection, retries, cost and notifications. Setup enables no send, refund or reship.
